claims.text: Both container_1445144423722_0020_01_000008 and container_1445144423722_0020_01_000009 appear in the task events of the Hadoop log, with their assignments and launches happening in quick succession.
The first container is assigned at 18:03:56 and launched at 18:03:56, while the second container is assigned at 18:04:04 and launched at 18:04:04.

This sequence suggests that the two containers are being launched in a burst of activity, with a gap of only 8 seconds between the assignment and launch of the first container and the assignment of the second container.
Furthermore, both containers are assigned to the same node, MSRA-SA-41.fareast.corp.microsoft.com:7109, and are using the same RMCommunicator Allocator and ContainerLauncher.
This repetition pattern in the evidence suggests that these errors recur without a corrective action in between, as the same sequence of events is repeated for the two containers.
